summary: Recommends always naming plays, tasks and blocks with descriptive names because Ansible prints them in its output.
questions: Should I give every task a name?
Why do task names matter in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Name plays, tasks and blocks
answer_card.answer_md: `name:` is optional but very useful: Ansible prints the name of each play, task and block it runs. Use names that describe what each does and why.
